title: zehneria scaberrima
intro: Zehneria scaberrima, commonly known as the Indian pennywort or bahuja, is a plant species in the family Cucurbitaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. Zehneria scaberrima has been reported to have health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its potential therapeutic actions in treating conditions like fever, digestive issues, and skin problems. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
